high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "raashiikhanna," who posted it 6 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The post features a close-up photo of a hand with a mehendi design on the palm. The mehendi design appears to be intricate and symmetrical, featuring a central symbol surrounded by decorative patterns. The background of the photo shows part of a car interior, specifically the dashboard and air vents, indicating that the person might be sitting inside a vehicle. The car's logo, which reads "LAND ROVER," is partially visible through the windshield.
